items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: And he’s definitely one of the best players I’ve ever played with.

ctx.x: I’m glad to hear you say that.

Oh yeah. It happens. I mean [inaudible] and Tony Retis and Kenny Washington, you know, now, I’m not saying they’re not tough, they’re not like there’s a certain thing you have to pass through to be friends with them, but it’s musical. And it’s also personal too in a way, I mean they’re not going to want to be friends with you if you’re a bad guy, but you know, that being said, once you pass a certain musical threshold you’re cool. But I don’t think a guy like, let’s say Kenny Washington, the guys been on a lot of…
You’re not in the minor leagues now, when you’re with those guys.
